cases.assertion: The fixed runtime plus receive, decoder, and staging reservations fit the supplied process limit and each named peak is measured.
Incremental frames cross one bounded memory prefix into exactly one overflow file and expose one storage-independent commit iterator.
Frame, event, transaction-byte, and transaction-event checks occur before allocation; rejection poisons commit and emits no feedback permit.
Per-filesystem budget and emergency reserve reject preallocation before bytes are written.
An environmental disk-space refusal safe-stops without producing a feedback-eligible transaction; the broader canonical SCN-SPOOL-SQLITE-ENOSPC remains owned by boring-cdc-m2-journal.
A changed overflow frame checksum is detected before the commit consumer can publish it.
Only after exclusive state lock, owned dead uncommitted spools are removed while malformed and contradictory files quarantine and block.
A just-at-limit commit burst uses file spill, reports positive spill and zero stream delta, and remains commit-ready without itself granting feedback.
An over-limit transaction stays bounded and emits capture epoch, XID, final LSN, observed limits, stable fingerprint, and feedback_permitted=false.
Startup removes one owned dead-run spool, quarantines malformed and contradictory spools, and blocks source admission.
